Kaavakuva: kolme yhtä suurta kuutiota, j: Schematic figure: three equally large cubes, each with a volume of 10 cm³, made of pine, aluminium and iron. The cubes are the same size, but their masses are 5.0 g, 27 g and 79 g. The lengths of the horizontal bars showing mass are to scale: the bar of the iron cube is more than ten times as long as the bar of the pine cube.
Kuvaaja mittakaavassa: massa tilavuuden: Graph to scale: mass as a function of volume for three substances. Each substance gives a straight line through the origin: the density of water is 1.00 g/cm³, that of aluminium 2.70 g/cm³ and that of iron 7.87 g/cm³. The greater the density, the steeper the line. A triangle showing the slope is drawn on the iron line, where the volume increases by 20 cm³ and the mass by about 157 g.
Periaatekuva tilavuuden mittaamisesta ve: Schematic figure of measuring volume by displacement of water. In the left measuring cylinder the water reaches the 40 ml mark. When a stone is lowered in, the water rises in the right measuring cylinder to the 70 ml mark. The volume of the stone is the difference of the volumes, 30 ml, that is, 30 cm³.
